# Not yet verified

The spec lists these as open; they are reported, never hidden:

- fill\_rate is a C\# double that serialises 1.0 as 1; bindings must read it as a float.
- since.pymzlib is null until released; Rust and R are not yet ported.
- Bulk spellings are the cross-binding decision of 2026-09-23: a separate &lt;verb&gt;\_many in every binding (R too, not vectorisation). Rust and R names here are intended, not yet ported.
